items.title: Antonelli can clinch the title in Austin, but only with a win
items.summary: Formula1.com's preview says Kimi Antonelli must win the race to take the Drivers' title this weekend, and would also need other results to fall his way: Russell finishing no higher than ninth and Hamilton no higher than fifth, per the article's scenario.
items.why_it_matters: The permutations are conditional on a win; anything less defers the celebrations. Check live standings before quoting points gaps, as the article's figures are as of its publication.

items.title: C2/C3/C4 for COTA, with wear rather than graining the key factor
items.summary: Pirelli brings C2 hard, C3 medium and C4 soft to a standard-format weekend: two hard, three medium and eight soft sets, plus an extra soft for Q3 runners. Pirelli expects high wear on an ageing surface, with Turns 9-11 resurfaced this year, and says the C2 could favour a one-stop race, with heat opening the door to alternatives.
items.why_it_matters: The strategy question is whether the harder compound allows long stints or Texas heat pushes teams to alternative plans. Pirelli's one-stop view is a pre-weekend expectation, not a result.

items.title: Upgrade race continues: McLaren plan more, Mercedes want to understand Malaysia package
items.summary: McLaren plan further upgrades in Austin building on the Baku package. Mercedes have not announced new parts but will use a three-practice weekend to understand the upgrade introduced in Malaysia, which they have struggled to exploit fully. Verstappen has won the last two races for Red Bull.
items.why_it_matters: Practice pace is the first evidence of whether the form swings seen this season continue. Confirmed parts should be checked against the FIA car-presentation filings when published.

items.title: Haas confirm Rafael Camara for 2027; Racing Bulls seats open
items.summary: Haas announced F2 leader Rafael Camara on a multi-year deal, expected to partner Ollie Bearman in 2027. Formula1.com says Racing Bulls are the only team with an official vacancy, with neither driver confirmed.
items.why_it_matters: A 2027 announcement, not a change for this weekend; Camara has not yet appeared in an FP1 session.
